# Page-system checklist {#sec-page-system-checklist}

This appendix makes the first appendix opener, running furniture, contents
entry, and alphabetic numbering visible in every applicable output.

## Required opening pages

- The title uses book metadata rather than manuscript-only wording.
- Publication data remains a conspicuous placeholder until an edition supplies
  verified rights and identifier records.
- The optional dedication has no heading or folio in print.
- Parts, chapters, and appendices begin on recto pages in print profiles.
- The reserved verso after the dedication contains no text or page furniture.
- Long headings wrap inside the live area and remain with following prose.
- Split paragraphs retain at least two lines on each side of a page boundary.

The structural source remains ordinary Quarto Markdown. Backend-specific code
is confined to template partials. The PDF validator discovers division pages
from unique opening prose rather than freezing their page numbers.

## Numbered appendix elements {#sec-appendix-numbering}

This section is a compact numbering specimen. @fig-appendix-signal,
@tbl-appendix-prefixes, @eq-appendix-scale, @lst-appendix-check,
@thm-appendix-ordering, @nte-appendix-portability, @wrn-appendix-manual-labels,
and @exr-appendix-review must all use the current appendix letter rather than a
main-matter chapter number or a manually authored prefix.

An appendix-to-chapter route returns to @sec-heading-hierarchy and
@eq-ohms-law. Appendix citations also join the book's one shared bibliography;
the literate-programming example [@knuth1984] must not create a second reference
list or a duplicate entry.

![A small signal-chain fixture reused to verify appendix-local figure numbering.](../figures/signal-chain.svg){#fig-appendix-signal fig-alt="A three-stage signal chain runs from a sensor through signal conditioning to a decision stage." width="80%"}

| Element | Required prefix |
|:--------|:----------------|
| Section | A.2 |
| Figure | A.1 |
| Table | A.1 |
| Equation | A.1 |
| Listing | A.1 |
| Exercise | A.1 |

: Appendix-local numbering acceptance matrix {#tbl-appendix-prefixes}

The specimen relationship is

$$
s_{n+1} = 2s_n + 1.
$$ {#eq-appendix-scale}

```{#lst-appendix-check .text lst-cap="A backend-neutral appendix check"}
assert current_appendix == "A"
assert local_figure == "A.1"
```

::: {#thm-appendix-ordering}
## Appendix ordering invariant

Within one appendix, each numbered family advances independently while sharing
the appendix letter.
:::

::: {#nte-appendix-portability .callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Portable numbering

Authors provide stable identifiers; the active backend provides every visible
letter, number, and localized label.
:::

::: {#wrn-appendix-manual-labels .callout-warning appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Do not type appendix numbers

A literal “A.1” in explanatory prose is never a substitute for a generated
cross-reference because editions may reorder or omit appendices.
:::

::: {#exr-appendix-review}
## Review an appendix reference

Move a numbered object within this appendix and confirm that references update
without editing prose.
:::

::: {#sol-appendix-review}
## Review an appendix reference

Render every supported format and compare the generated reference rather than
the object's page position.
:::
